summary.name: Volumetric Fire & Smoke
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: emissive 3D flame and translucent smoke render as coherent raymarched volumes with readable depth, buoyant motion, cooling soot and light spill on a dark or contrasting stage. Flat glow sprites, liquid blobs and particle showers are not acceptable substitutes.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: flame, smoke, heat and explosion-aftermath subjects, including the optional blast_aftermath recipe for staged shockwave causality. Inferred: short illustrative shots of ignition, tall flame and cooling smoke. Interactive HTML use is unspecified beyond reduced-motion controls where interaction is supported.
summary.limitations: Explicit: the volume is an illustrative procedural approximation, not a combustion solver, and temperature colors are approximate rather than measured. Physically simulated full shots need Blender/Cycles baked gas frames, which are unavailable here and must be reported as missing. Step caps, bounded resolution and clamped exposure apply.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent, so the hex values are authored example suggestions for new artwork, not approved exact colors. Example tokens: background #101218, foreground #F6EFE3, coal #4B403A, flame_core #FFF0BC, flame_amber #FFAD42, flame_orange #F05A28, smoke #747B86. Background is the scene field only; flame emission, soot and materials are separate roles. No gradient is added. Task-approved colors override these values, and contrast must be checked on composited pixels.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit 3s preview timing: ignition 0–0.6s, tall readable flame 0.6–2.0s, cooling translucent smoke 2.0–3.0s. The volume advects upward from closed-form time functions, and every seek redraws one frame from paused timeline time. Sharp cuts, impacts, constant-speed sections and reading holds are preserved; easing is optional. Interaction: reduced-motion controls only where supported, otherwise unspecified.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style itself. The task may choose music, ambience, voice or silence; mechanism or combustion sounds should match only visible action. Honor supplied audio and authorized assets, since catalog previews are silent. Do not default to instrumental music without stating assumptions, and do not invent available audio assets.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are required: the procedural volume is generated in-browser from shader code and seeded noise. Local fonts and assets must load before rendering. Exact copy, duration, aspect ratio and output path are task inputs. Motion references are optional and none are selected (candidate list empty). Baked Blender frames are unavailable and reported as missing.
summary.combinations: Compatibility suggestions, not limits: style-061 for grounded environmental illumination and style-105 for measured visual and audio event timing. Keep Volumetric Fire & Smoke dominant, share one timing system and one set of material and background roles, and avoid competing full-frame treatments or invented physics claims.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: bounded raw WebGL2 with GLSL fragment raymarching at about 640×360 internal resolution, ≤64 primary and ≤6 light steps, seeded fBm noise. Motion engine: GSAP paused timeline drives time uniforms, with one owner per property. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default for check, snapshot and delivery render; Remotion only on a recorded fallback. chroma.js is optional for contrast checks. Verify decoded frames, audio sync and loop continuity.
